intro: Palau is a presidential republic in free association with the United States.

chapters.title: How it works
text: The president is elected for four years; Surangel Whipps Jr. was re-elected in 2024. Congress has a Senate and a House of Delegates. Traditional chiefs advise on custom.

chapters.title: Ties with Taiwan
text: Palau is one of the few countries that recognise Taiwan.
